Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment specifically analyzed the effect of ispinesib treatment on phosphotyrosine levels in naive cells at two timepoints (6h and 3 weeks) compared to vehicle/DMSO controls. While the paper discusses many other drug combinations (saracatinib, dasatinib, erlotinib) and genetic perturbations (shRNA), these were used for viability assays and western blots, not the TMT-multiplexed phosphoproteomics dataset (PXD030715).

base_candidates_ranked.reason: The experiment used TMT 10-plex labeling and data-dependent acquisition (DDA) on a Q Exactive Plus.

modifier_candidates_ranked.reason: Specific use of phosphotyrosine immunoprecipitation (IP) with 4G10 and PT-66 antibodies followed by IMAC enrichment.

workflow: Lyophilized peptides were labeled using tandem mas tag (TMT) 10-plex
The Q Exactive Plus was operated in data-dependent acquisition (DDA) mode
Phosphotyrosine enrichment of labeled samples was performed using a phospohotyrosine immunoprecipitation (IP) followed by immobilized metal affinity chromatography (IMAC)
differential: relative quantification was calculated as the log2 fold change for each sample over the average signal from the DMSO control
Hierarchical clustering of phosphosites was performed
Peptides were filtered using the following criteria: ... >= 1 tyrosine phosphorylated residue
search_parameters: fixed modifications of cysteine carbamidomethylation, TMT-labeled lysine and TMT-labeled protein N-terminals
Variable modifications were oxidized methionine and serine, threonine, and tyrosine phosphorylation

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The analysis is strictly focused on phosphotyrosine (pTyr) sites, utilizing a dual-enrichment strategy (IP + IMAC) and TMT quantification.

acquisition: The Q Exactive Plus was operated in data-dependent acquisition (DDA) mode
labeling: Lyophilized peptides were labeled using tandem mas tag (TMT) 10-plex (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
quantification: TMT reporter ions were added together across scans of the same pTyr peptide, and relative quantification was calculated as the log2 fold change
specialized: Phosphotyrosine enrichment of labeled samples was performed using a phospohotyrosine immunoprecipitation (IP) followed by immobilized metal affinity chromatography (IMAC).
pTyr peptides were isolated by imunoprecipitation & immobilized metal affinity purification prior to LC-MS/MS analysis.

MStype_prompt.notes: The experiment specifically targeted the phosphotyrosine (pTyr) proteome using a combination of IP (4G10 and PT-66 antibodies) and IMAC enrichment, followed by TMT 10-plex labeling and DDA acquisition on a Q Exactive Plus.

Treatment_prompt.reasoning: we treated ispinesib-naive Trp53/Pten−/− cells with vehicle or with ispinesib for 6 h or for 3 weeks and performed phosphotyrosine proteomics.
